Added Inherited IRA (optional) section to the Scenarios page (Beneficiary, Balance, decedent death year/age, RMDs-already-started checkbox, beneficiary relationship/classification dropdowns), wired into save/load round-trip and inline blocking-flag rendering. Verified end-to-end with Playwright against the real BFF+UI stack, including a real save/GET round-trip. Added 6 new AppTest tests + expanded the Instructions page with a matching explanatory section. Replaced the partial (ages 50-95), verified=False placeholder table with the full IRS Pub. 590-B (2025) Appendix B Table I (ages 0-120+), cross-checked directly against the primary-source PDF (pp. 50-51), and flipped verified=True. Ages 80-95 were already correct by coincidence; ages 50-79 in the old placeholder were wrong (off by ~1.7-2.8) and are now corrected. Added a regression test pinning verified=True + spot-checked divisors.

Threaded inherited_accounts through 005 end-to-end: monte_carlo.py's run_simulation() (serial + parallel/multiprocessing worker dispatch, each path getting its own fresh independently-copied InheritedAccountBalance list), simulation/compare.py's 4 axis functions, and the BFF (routes/simulations.py, routes/comparisons.py's simulated path) -- removed the now-obsolete inherited_accounts_unsupported_for_simulation 422 rejection and its now-dead Streamlit UI special-casing. Verified against the real scenario b.yaml (which has an inherited account) end-to-end via the BFF: Monte Carlo comparison now returns 200 instead of the old 422/500. 6 new regression tests (path-isolation under both serial and forced-parallel dispatch, cross-candidate isolation, BFF-level success). Full suite: 297 (root) + 55 (bff) + 89 (streamlit) passed.

Shipped v1: templated (non-AI) plain-language explanations, inline under each chart via a collapsed expander, on both Run Simulation and Compare. New apps/streamlit_ui/src/rp_ui/narration.py: narrate_metrics() (pure, builds label/value/explanation entries from 007's existing SummaryStatistics JSON -- no backend changes) + render_results_explanation() (Streamlit rendering, mirrors formatting.py/verification.py's pure/render split). Run Simulation shows success rate as 'N of M paths' (path count from its own response); Compare shows percentage-only per candidate (no path count in its response) plus 2 new table columns (IRMAA, NIIT) that were computed but not previously shown. Points at the existing verification indicator by name rather than duplicating unverified-figure reporting. 10 new unit tests + 4 existing integration tests updated for the richer mock response shape. Full suite: 297 (root) + 55 (bff) + 99 (streamlit) passed. AI-generated narration explicitly deferred as future follow-on work, per this session's design decision with the user.

Implemented via specs/013-inherited-ira-edge-cases (shared with rp-c8b/rp-iju since all three modify the same compute_inherited_rmd() function/validation flags). Pre-RBD non-EDB: compute_inherited_rmd() now returns required_amount=0.0 for every year before the (unchanged) death_year+10 deadline, per IRS Pub. 590-B (2025) p.10 'no distribution is required for any year before the 10th year.' scenario.validation's decedent_was_taking_rmds=False blocking flag removed. 4 new unit tests + BFF-level end-to-end regression test. Full suite: 310 (root) + 61 (bff) + 99 (streamlit) passed.

Implemented via specs/013-inherited-ira-edge-cases (shared with rp-iju/rp-l4d). A Roth account is now always treated as pre-RBD regardless of decedent_was_taking_rmds's literal value (Roth owners never have lifetime RMDs), reusing rp-l4d's exact 'no annual RMD, full depletion at year 10' logic via one shared owner_died_before_rbd boolean. account_type != traditional blocking flag narrowed to allow roth (taxable stays blocked). Added an 'Account type' selector to the Scenarios page's Inherited IRA form (previously hardcoded to traditional, so Roth was unreachable from the UI even once the engine supported it) + rewrote stale Instructions-page copy. 3 new unit tests + BFF-level end-to-end regression test. Full suite: 310 (root) + 61 (bff) + 99 (streamlit) passed.

Implemented via specs/013-inherited-ira-edge-cases (shared with rp-c8b/rp-l4d), citing IRS Pub. 590-B (2025) pp.8-11 directly. Non-spouse EDB: annual divisor via 'longer of' beneficiary-vs-owner life expectancy when post-RBD (decrement-by-1 method), beneficiary-only when pre-RBD/Roth. Spouse EDB: divisor recalculated fresh every year (not decremented) + delayed start until the year the owner would have reached RBD when pre-RBD (reuses rmd.py's own RMD_START_AGE). Minor-child EDB: same non-spouse divisor formula, but depletion_deadline_year converts to majority_year+10 once they turn 21 (IRS's own age-21 majority rule for this purpose), computed once at resolution time from the beneficiary's own current_age. A true (non-minor) EDB gets a far-future sentinel deadline (no 10-year clock of their own). beneficiary_classification blocking flag removed; closed a pre-existing gap by adding a new trust_or_entity blocking flag (newly reachable now that classification alone no longer blocks). Filed rp-kn5 separately: same primary source suggests the ALREADY-SHIPPED non-EDB post-RBD divisor (012, unchanged here) may also need this 'longer of' comparison -- deliberately not bundled into this scope-boundary work. 12 new unit tests + parametrized BFF-level end-to-end regression tests + updated Scenarios page/Instructions copy. Full suite: 310 (root) + 61 (bff) + 99 (streamlit) passed.

Fixed: compare_claiming_age_grid() (both comparison/compare.py and simulation/compare.py) now validates each grid entry's keys match exactly the household's member person_names, raising ValueError (already mapped to a clean 422 by routes/comparisons.py) instead of letting an incomplete entry reach run_plan_projection()'s unconditional claiming_ages[member.person_name] lookup as an uncaught KeyError -> bare HTTP 500. Regression tests added at 3 layers: tests/unit/comparison/test_compare_claiming_age_grid.py, tests/unit/simulation/test_compare.py, services/bff/tests/integration/test_bff_lifecycle.py. Found by the new e2e/ Playwright suite (test_compare_page.py) driving a real married-household Compare form with Person 2 left blank -- exactly the scenario a real user could hit. Full suite: 313 (root) + 62 (bff) + 99 (streamlit) + 16 (e2e, new) all passing.
